notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new update to the game. Here's the change list :
[list]
[*]Added a Calibrate lag item in the option menu. It can be used when some lag is occurring when charging.
[*]Minor fixes for the achievements
[*]Bug fix where the fourth level would freeze upon pausing the game
[*]Fixed some French spelling mistakes
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added a Calibrate lag item in the option menu. It can be used when some lag is occurring when charging.

tags.bug: [*]Bug fix where the fourth level would freeze upon pausing the game
